title: Solution
description: One solution: YAML front matter and a human body, so that one solution is one pull request. The `answers` block is applicability metadata, not a rule engine — nothing is downloaded and evaluated on the client, and matching happens on the server against the signature. The body is what a person reads; `proposes` is what the client may be asked to do, and every entry must exist in the client's action vocabulary.

when.description: Applicability conditions on collected readings. Compared exactly, along the path actually walked — a wrong guess would reach a user.

text_by_lang.description: The human part, by language. Must contain `en`.
